name: Early Morning, Tarpon Springs
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Early Morning, Tarpon Springs” by George Inness (1892), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 64729. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
